parameters.content:
## Telegram Fitness Tracker Bot

**Commands:** /log, /stats, /weekly
**Auto:** Weekly summary every Sunday 8PM

**Setup:**
1. Set Telegram Bot credentials
2. Create Google Sheet 'Workouts': exercise, value, unit, userId, username, chatId, date, weekNumber, timestamp
3. Set group chat ID for weekly summary
